notes: Additive evidence; no original source snapshot or hold changed.
Sixteen rechecks complete the 26 held records in the final-41 selection, not all 59 holds across the 111-record manifest.
Only parsed operator-site evidence supplies candidates, all business-scoped and blocked pending explicit identity/editorial review.
Waterways are separate from species/method/trip types; only explicit relationships are emitted. No cross-product inference.
Indexed and parsed responses may be cached. Review date is not publication, direct-server retrieval time or current availability.
Source-access failure does not prove closure. No ratings, private contacts, verified credentials, ownership or legal identity are asserted.
The package is evidence for the existing editor, not a drop-in approved-data file or an instruction to clear holds.
